decisions.title: node:sqlite + JS KNN instead of native sqlite-vec
decisions.decision: Use Node's built-in node:sqlite with FTS5 and JS cosine KNN behind a Store interface
decisions.rationale: Zero native compilation; a native vec0 backend can be swapped in later

decisions.title: WASM tree-sitter grammars
decisions.decision: Use web-tree-sitter with prebuilt tree-sitter-wasm grammars
decisions.rationale: Works without a C/C++ toolchain and covers ~150 languages

decisions.title: RRF fusion for hybrid retrieval
decisions.decision: Fuse vector, BM25 and graph rankings with Reciprocal Rank Fusion (k=60); reranker optional
decisions.rationale: Simple, score-scale-free fusion that works without a trained reranker

decisions.title: Dual ESM + CJS packaging
decisions.decision: tsup emits ESM and CJS for ., ./cli and ./api
decisions.rationale: CommonJS consumers such as Electron apps must be able to require the package (v0.1.1 fix)
